style: Gritty comic-book style illustration for a dark-fantasy deckbuilder. Heavy, slightly rough black ink outlines with ink hatching in the shadows; cel shading with two or three tones per colour; a subtle grunge paper texture; saturated but slightly muted colours. No text, no letters, no numbers, no frame, no border, no watermark, no signature, no UI.
style_refs_note: The attached images are style references only. Copy ONLY their rendering style: line weight, ink hatching, cel shading, paper texture and level of detail. Do NOT copy their subject, pose, framing, composition or background colour; every image must look clearly different from them and follow the description below.
background: Background: a flat colour field crossed by sharp, jagged, diagonal brush-streak shapes in a darker tone.

layouts.Attack: Dynamic action moment with a strong diagonal; white curved motion arcs around what moves and a burst of debris, sparks or particles at the point of impact.
layouts.Skill: A clear defensive or utility moment, calmer than an attack: no punching motion. Add motion arcs only if something actually moves.
layouts.Power: Centered, iconic composition: the subject sits in the middle like an emblem with soft radiating light. No motion arcs, no impact burst.

Attack: full-body action shot of the character
